description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-replenishment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reorder" name="Reorder"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryReplenishment" name="Inventory Replenishment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Begin monitoring"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="Reorder threshold reached?" default="Flow_ThresholdNotReached"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMethod" name="Signal need to reorder"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Generate automated alert"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMerge" name="Merge reorder signals"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Evaluate supplier and place order" messageRef="Message_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery dates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectStock" name="Inspect stock quality"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockLevel <= reorderThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdNotReached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_Automated" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_Manual" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Automated_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manual_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Order" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_ExpectedDelivery" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpectedDelivery_Receive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_InspectStock" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Place" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_PlaceStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Place_Update" sourceRef="Task_PlaceStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryReplenishment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Inventory" name="Warehouse or store" processRef="Process_InventoryReplenishment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Reorder" messageRef="Message_Reorder" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Supplier"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
